notes: San Francisco Bay Guardian, 2011 to its last issues in October 2014, 185 items in the Internet Archive collection (some issues are there twice), read from the DjVu text. Hand-curated: news-word passages, article clusters and event passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, staff, tenants, performers or customers.

coverage.remaining: None: with this batch every issue in the collection has been read.
coverage.note: 185 items; 34,281 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, of which the advertisement filter marked 22,620 and kept 2,489 windows in 1,968 address clusters. Read in full: the 77 passages of the news-word pass over the raw text, the 87 clusters of article prose, and the 43 event-word passages for places printed without a number. The 239 event-word clusters under the tighter filter were not read. About 30 candidates were checked against the issue text and 21 written. Not entered: stories about private owners and tenants, four closings printed without a street number, and proposals that went no further in the paper. 21 findings, each quote found again in the issue's text. 13 resolved and published on 13 existing pages. 5 held as single facts on parcels with no page (2441 Mission, 2200 Cesar Chavez, 555 Fulton, 75 Howard, 1700 Mission). 3 unresolved: 38 Dolores and 1639 Market, which EAS does not join to one parcel, and 2050 Bryant, a number EAS no longer has. The audit flags 0 of 21.
